Functions re-exported from narwcr

Source: R/reexports.R
narwcr-layer.Rd

Reading and standardising a NARWC extract used to live in this package. It now lives in narwcr, which msomgom and any other analysis of the same archive share, so that there is one vocabulary and one set of handbook code books rather than one per package.

Details

They are re-exported here so that library(distsamp) still gives you a working pipeline from a file to a set of segments, and so that existing code and examples keep running unchanged. They are the same functions: documented, tested and versioned in narwcr.

Where each one is documented

Reading

narwcr::read_narwc(), narwcr::standardize_narwc_columns(), narwcr::narwc_column_mapping()

Filling

narwcr::fill_narwc(), narwcr::narwc_fill_columns(), narwcr::narwc_never_fill()

Validating

narwcr::narwc_checks(), narwcr::narwc_finding(). validate_narwc() is not re-exported: this package defines its own wrapper so that distsamp_checks() run by default. See validate_narwc().

Handbook code books

narwcr::narwc_codes(), narwcr::narwc_schema(), narwcr::narwc_strip_bins(), narwcr::narwc_profiles()

Effort

narwcr::flag_effort(), narwcr::visibility_ok(), narwcr::make_leg_id(), narwcr::on_effort_census_rows()

Cloud storage

narwcr::narwc_fetch(), narwcr::narwc_cloud_roots()
